'''Draerd''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. Draerd was one of the many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to fall during the [[Sacking of Coruscant|battle]] at [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Great Galactic War]].
